test: none: open on SolidCraft's truck kernel (kernel work paused under tangency-labs/solidcraft#3992); geometry is the report's repro_xz.json, its mirrored variant and its control t1, reproduced on 0.29.0 with solidcraft-cli
summary: A revolve cut of a small round groove into a stepped cup needed a 'Boolean retry: tool displacement' on SolidCraft's truck kernel every time (#8038). The report's repro_xz.json: on the XZ plane a cup section, the polygon (r, z) (75, 54.6), (75, 128.8), (50.15, 128.8), (50.15, 105.1), (47, 105.1), (47, 101.1), (56, 101.1), (57, 100.1), (57, 54.6) (a wall r 57..75 for z 54.6..100.1, a 1 mm chamfer, a ledge in to r 47 for z 101.1..105.1 and the bore r 50.15 above the step at z = 105.1), revolved a full turn about Z; then a groove, two lines from (49.65, 106.4) round a square corner at (49.65, 104.9) to (51.15, 104.9) and a 270 degree arc of radius 1.5 about (51.15, 106.4) back to the start, revolved and cut. The groove (z 104.9..107.9) straddles the bore wall r = 50.15 (0.5 inside the bore) just above the step, its lowest 0.2 below the step's plane, in the ledge. Replayed with solidcraft-cli 0.29.0 (truck; the XZ sketch's v is -z, so the cup sits at z 54.6..128.8): the cut builds only after 'Boolean retry: tool displacement 3.768070e-4 mm, rotation 2.000000e-6 rad', as reported (also on 0.25.0 and 0.18.2), and the same with both sections drawn at x < 0 (the report's repro_xz_sym); drawn on the YZ plane, which puts the same cup at z -128.8..-54.6 (its mirror image in z = 0), it needs no retry, and the report's control t1 (a circle of diameter 6 on the wall of a plain tube's bore, revolved and cut) needs none either. Not fixed on truck: kernel work is paused (tangency-labs/solidcraft#3992), and the `pr` link is the SMLib kernel move (tangency-labs/solidcraft#4012). The cases build the sections as revolve steps (the cup's polygon, the groove's two lines and arc; the t1 groove a circle) on the XZ plane (u = x, v = z), the mirrored one on the YZ plane, and cut. Everything is a solid of revolution about Z, so each volume is 2 pi times its section's first moment int r dA (Pappus): the cup's polygon by Green's theorem (checked against a sum over triangles and a randomised QMC over the section, within 0.95 of its standard errors); the groove's part in the cup in closed form (the disc and the square less their shared quarter disc, less the part on the bore's side of the step: a strip of the square and a strip of the disc, the latter by its antiderivative; checked by quadrature, and by randomised QMC over the groove's box with a point-in-polygon test, within 0.81 and 0.53 standard errors). Every case expects one lump, a manifold solid and its volume within 0.01 mm^3. Expected values are analytic; nothing comes from a commercial CAD product.

cases.name: cup_alone
cases.note: Control: the report's cup, its section revolved a full turn about Z (outer wall r 75; for z 54.6..100.1 the bore r 57, then a 1 mm chamfer and a ledge in to r 47 for z 101.1..105.1, and above the step at z = 105.1 the bore r 50.15).

volume.formula: 2*pi times the section's first moment int r dA (Pappus; everything is revolved a full turn about Z): the cup's section, the polygon (r, z) (75, 54.6), (75, 128.8), (50.15, 128.8), (50.15, 105.1), (47, 105.1), (47, 101.1), (56, 101.1), (57, 100.1), (57, 54.6), int r dA = sum over its edges of dz*(r1^2 + r1*r2 + r2^2)/6 = 98955.566708333; tol 0.01 mm^3

cases.name: groove_cut
cases.note: The report's case (repro_xz.json): the groove revolved and cut from the cup, straddling the bore wall r = 50.15 just above the step z = 105.1, its lowest 0.2 below the step's plane, in the ledge. On SolidCraft 0.29.0 (truck) the cut builds only after a retry with the tool moved ('Boolean retry: tool displacement 3.768070e-4 mm, rotation 2.000000e-6 rad').
